what_it_measures: One composite base compressing 50 networks trained this session. Each is below the admission threshold alone, but together they move the fold-378 out-of-fold score from 1.6645302 to 1.6639663. Delivering that one base at a time would cost 50 probes; compressed it costs one probe and 0.51 df.

offline_evidence.why_the_deployment_gain_barely_drops: at correlation 0.9989 the E[v^2] proxy error and the Gram mismatch cancel, which is the regime 155-159 identified as safe. Every earlier candidate that looked good offline and collapsed in deployment sat below 0.99.

the_risk_this_probe_measures: The composite's weights are fitted on fold-378 labels and applied at anchor 408. FINDINGS 2.1 records that fold-378 rankings invert against the real target, which is exactly why this project never stacks on that fold. The downside is bounded: if the weights do not transfer, the recovered moment is poor, the ridge gives the base a small weight and the cost is about 0.5 degrees of freedom. The upside is the largest offline gain measured in this session.

reading_key.if_it_fails: branch closed; no re-parameterisation, no reweighted composite, no second probe on the same 50 models
